name: herdr (outside of container)
description: Client-only herdr CLI (herdrdev/herdr) that talks to a Herdr server running on the host through a bind-mounted Unix socket. Never starts a local server or TUI, so several dev containers can share one host Herdr server.

version.description: Version of herdr to install (e.g. 'latest' or a specific tag like 'v0.9.4'). Match the host Herdr server version.

containerSocketPath.description: Absolute path to the mounted host API socket inside the container. Host source paths are configured in devcontainer.json mounts.
